_comment: ngsolve dg_methods#8 (no tanh in the CoefficientFunction namespace; build it from exp). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.4. tanh really is absent and an unqualified tanh(x) raises NameError "name 'tanh' is not defined", which is what the claim quotes. CORRECTION: the claim's parenthetical 'no tanh/sinh/cosh' is FALSE -- ngsolve.sinh and ngsolve.cosh both exist and both evaluate on a CoefficientFunction, matching math.sinh/math.cosh at three sample points; only tanh is missing. Every function the claim lists as present (exp/log/sin/cos/tan/atan/atan2) is present. Both the claim's exp identity and the sinh/cosh quotient reproduce math.tanh at those points. Mutation: pointing the presence probe at 'tan' instead of 'tanh' removes the NameError and the fixture fails on tanh_call_raises_nameerror.
